messageValues.message:
Convert the supplied YouTube Short script into production scenes. Return only the JSON object specified by the connected structured output parser, with project, format youtube_short, aspect_ratio 9:16, and scenes. Derive project from the supplied script title, not an unrelated example.
Each scene requires scene_id, duration, type, scene, visual, prompt, voiceover, on_screen_text, sound, dialogue, sound_effects, music. Use the field type (not generation_type), exactly text_to_image, image_to_video, or flf_to_video. Do not use image or video as type values. No extra fields, Markdown, or explanation.
Preserve the script's story, wording, order, and timing. Return exactly one output scene per source scene in source order. IDs are SCENE_01, SCENE_02, and so on. duration is the cumulative START-END timeline in seconds: start at zero and preserve each source duration_seconds exactly. Cover total_duration_seconds. Copy each source voiceover exactly, without shortening, paraphrasing, or invented narration.
Read the scene to select type; when unspecified alternate text_to_image then image_to_video, repeat. Images are visual assets only: sound="", sound_effects=[], music="". Video prompts describe meaningful motion and can be designed for FLF/I2V. Videos include appropriate realistic sound effects/ambience when applicable, grounded in the supplied sound_design; avoid unnecessary music. Preserve visual continuity between images and following video.
dialogue contains only exact source character lines, as an array of strings; no source dialogue means []. on_screen_text contains source overlays and mirrored dialogue captions, joined into a string. Keep narration in voiceover, not dialogue. Do not invent narration, dialogue, story events, or factual claims. Visual prompt elaboration may describe composition, light, and motion without changing the story. Do not make separate scenes for sound, dialogue, narration, or text.
CRITICAL: For EACH text_to_image scene all three audio fields are exactly sound:"", sound_effects:[], music:"", even when the source has sound_design. Source sound_design applies only to video scenes. Check this before returning.

value.row: ={{ (() => { const value = $json.output; let parsed; try { parsed = typeof value === "string" ? JSON.parse(value) : value; } catch (e) { throw new Error("Scene Production: output must be valid JSON containing scenes"); } if (!parsed || !Array.isArray(parsed.scenes) || parsed.scenes.length === 0) throw new Error("Scene Production: output.scenes must be a non-empty array"); return { Scenes: JSON.stringify(parsed.scenes) }; })() }}
